evidence.oauth: Live server accepted dynamic registration. App generated PKCE S256, state, loopback redirect and mcp:read URL. Same URL reached real sign-in page in independent integrated browser. No user login or token exchange completed yet. Twelve protocol unit tests use real SDK but fake HTTP responses.
evidence.local: macOS default HTTPS handler is Chrome. All three main Chrome processes use automation profiles/no-startup-window; two also headless and proxy127.0.0.1:9 with blocked DNS. Native Chrome inspection timed out. No evidence of which process received the openExternal event.
evidence.install: Installer persists reviewed prompt+rules+examples with toolNames:[] then adds skillId to chosen agent preserving existing tools; no scripts imported. Other preexisting routing may add other skills/tools.
